notes.title: Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival
notes.notes: [p][b]DESERT OF ASH: a Post-Apocalyptic Gay Sex Simulator[/b] is participating in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/studioelan/sale/fallinlovefestival2025"]Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival[/url]! From September 24 to October 1, you can check out a plethora of romance-focused VNs with demos and sales.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205973/fbf5549e2a53cd91efa7a4a28dd5fb6133e5f386.png"][/img][/p][p]If you haven't tried the demo for [b]DESERT OF ASH[/b] yet, this is a great time to do so and get a glimpse of a few of the guys you can pursue, whether for a quick hook-up or something more. We've also recently updated the demo with some additional polish and greater accessibility, so check it out![/p][p][/p][p]Furthermore, the lead developer will be livestreaming the game as part of the festival on Tuesday at 1:30 PM MDT! He will be showcasing a section further into the game focusing on Julian, the hunky mechanic![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205973/1c21807e5e399f6d229ce454bd1953e76214f300.png"][/img][/p][p]Not every guy in DESERT OF ASH wants more than a fun time, but your relationship with Julian has the potential to evolve into something deeper. You can even take him on a movie date, so he's the perfect guy to show off for the Fall in Love Festival![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205973/748e2d37690e2dcb92c00ffc565561077392bba0.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the festival. Get out there and find some hot guys to smooch![/p]
